[[File:Gelatinous abomination icon.png|left]]
The '''gelatinous abominations''' are a species of monster introduced with the [[Troll Warzone]], said to be created by the [[troll]], [[Magic Stick]]. They are given as a low level [[Slayer assignment]] and can be found in the [[Burthorpe Slayer Cave]] in Ewean's Grove, just south-west of the [[stone circle]] in [[Taverley]]. [[Spiked gauntlets]], available to buy for 6 coins from any [[Slayer Masters|Slayer Master]], are required in order to kill them. [[Turael]] offers spiked gauntlets free of charge. The gauntlets must be worn, not just be in the [[backpack]].

Gelatinous abominations are one of the few monsters to drop [[gold charm]]s for [[free-to-play]] players.

The player will automatically rip out the heart of the abomination at one life point and will only auto-rip one abomination–even if several are at one life point at the same time. You can attack another abomination during the ripping animation.

A slain gelatinous abomination does not drop its loot until about five seconds after the player receives experience from the kill. This loot despawns 30 seconds after it appears.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=This Week In RuneScape: Bug Fixes & More|date=17 May 2021}}
** Corrected a situation which could lead to players becoming stuck in the Gelatinous Abomination Cave in the [[Troll Warzone|Burthorpe tutorial]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=September Mobile Update|date=2 September 2019}}
** Burthorpe and Taverley Decluttering

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (18 June 2018)|date=18 June 2018}}
** Made some improvements to gelatinous abominations: 
*** Crush op has been removed.
*** On getting the NPC down to 1 health, the player will automatically run in to finish them.
*** Ensured attack is always the leftclick option.
*** Improved messaging about spiked gauntlets.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (12 December 2016)|date=12 December 2016}}
** An issue where the warning message was blocked by target information when fighting gelatinous abomination without spiked gauntlets.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (5 February 2013)|date=5 February 2013}}
** Players will now automatically crush abominations when they have low health as long as they have the spiked gauntlets equipped

* {{UL|type=update|update=Troll Warzone|date=31 January 2012}}
** Added to game.
